blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large generative models can recover realistic detail in real-world video super-resolution (VSR), but processing an entire video with them is computationally expensive.
In this work, we present RelayVSR , a streaming VSR framework built on the Sparse Generative Relay mechanism.
A large generative model generates reference latents for sparse keyframes, while a lightweight VSR network uses these references and low-resolution video to super-resolve every frame.
The lightweight VSR network, implemented as a Dual-Memory Video Transformer, reuses keyframe information across frames and updates recent video context, supporting first-keyframe conditioning and dual-endpoint conditioning with bounded lookahead.
However, errors in shared keyframes can propagate and accumulate across output frames, making keyframe quality alone an insufficient optimization target.
We address this collaboration gap with Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO), which uses reinforcement learning to update the large generative model with two reward levels: a system-level reward evaluates videos produced by the fixed lightweight VSR network, while a reference-level reward evaluates decoded keyframe quality.
VARO improves final video quality over direct joint training, and its dual-level rewards outperform a system-level reward alone.
At 1080p on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, dual-endpoint RelayVSR with a 15-frame keyframe interval reaches 29.29 FPS, 13.82 GB peak GPU memory, and 0.327 s first-frame model latency, compared with 7.80 FPS, 24.447 GB, and 2.83 s for FlashVSR-Tiny.
The code is available at https://github.com/kopperx/RelayVSR .
blocks.zh:
大型基因模型可以在现实世界的视频超解析(VSR)中恢复现实细节,但用它们处理整个视频则计算成本昂贵.
在这项工作中,我们介绍了RelayVSR,这是一个基于Sparse Generative Relay机制的流式VSR框架.
一个大的基因模型为稀疏的密钥帧产生参考潜质,而轻量级的VSR网络则使用这些参考和低分辨率视频来超解每个帧.
轻量级VSR网络,作为双记忆视频变换器实施,跨帧重用密钥帧信息,并更新近期视频上下文,支持一键帧配置和双端点配置与有边框的外观头.
然而,共享键框的错误可以在产出框中传播和累积,使单是键框质量就不够优化的目标.
我们解决了与Video-Aware Reference Optimation(VARO)的这一合作差距,VARO利用强化学习来更新大基因模型,具有两个奖励级别:系统级奖励评价固定轻量级VSR网络制作的视频,而参考级奖励评价解码密钥帧质量.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Streaming video super-resolution (VSR) aims to produce high-quality, high-resolution video in real time from degraded low-resolution inputs ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) .
To improve output quality, recent diffusion-based VSR methods draw on pretrained video generation models.
Their learned priors help synthesize realistic textures and fine details ( Xie et al., 2025 ) .
However, running these large models is computationally expensive, especially at high output resolutions ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
流媒体超清视频(VSR)旨在通过退化低清输入( Zhu等,2026年)实时制作优质高清视频.
为了提高产出质量,最近基于传播的VSR方法借鉴了经过预先训练的视频生成模型.
他们所学的前科有助于合成现实的纹理和细微的细节(谢等人,2025年).
然而,运行这些大型模型在计算上是昂贵的,特别是在高输出分辨率时(Wang等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
Recent work has reduced this cost by replacing iterative denoising with a single generative forward pass ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) .
This avoids repeatedly evaluating a large model for the same video.
Further improvements target attention and decoding, two major sources of inference overhead.
Local or sparse attention reduces computation over video latents, while lightweight decoders accelerate high-resolution reconstruction ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) .
These advances have substantially reduced both sampling cost and the overhead of each forward pass.
However, even single-step inference in these approaches requires a large generative model to process spatiotemporal latents spanning the video sequence ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ) .
Further optimizations of the generative backbone offer diminishing returns.
We therefore turn to a different question: Do we need a large generative model to process every frame for high-quality video super-resolution?
blocks.zh:
最近的工作通过用单一基因前传取代迭代代名词,降低了这一成本(Chen等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)。
这避免了重复评价同一视频的大型模型.
进一步改进的目标是注意和解码,这是推断间接费用的两个主要来源。
局部或稀疏的注意减少了对视频潜伏的计算,而轻量级解码器则加速高分辨率重建( Zhu等人,2026年; Yan等人,2026年).
这些进展大大减少了抽样费用,也大大降低了每次前行的间接费用。
然而,即使对这些方法进行单步推论,也需要一个大的基因模型来处理跨越视频序列的瞬间潜伏(Zhuang等人,2026年;Yan等人,2026年)。
基因骨干的进一步优化带来收益的减少。
因此,我们讨论另一个问题: 我们需要一个大基因模型来处理每个帧的高质量视频超分辨率吗?

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce RelayVSR , an efficient streaming VSR framework built on a (i) Sparse Generative Relay mechanism.
A large generative model enhances only sparse keyframes, while a lightweight VSR network super-resolves every frame using the LR video and the generated reference latents.
The LR video provides frame-specific content and motion cues, while the enhanced keyframes supply fine details to guide super-resolution.
For each interval, RelayVSR can use the first keyframe alone to avoid input lookahead or both endpoints for richer reference guidance with bounded lookahead.
The keyframe interval determines how often the large generative model updates these references and therefore its amortized cost per output frame.
Fig. 1 illustrates this schedule alongside representative VSR results.
At 1080p on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, the complete system in dual-endpoint mode with a 15-frame keyframe interval runs at 29.29 FPS with 13.82 GB peak GPU memory, compared with 7.80 FPS and 24.447 GB for FlashVSR-Tiny.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们引入了RelayVSR,这是一个基于(一) Sparse Generative Relay机制的高效流式VSR框架.
一个大的基因模型只能增强稀疏的键框,而一个轻量级的VSR网络超级解析器则使用LR视频和生成的参考潜伏物对每个帧进行解析.
LR视频提供特定帧的内容和运动提示,而增强键帧则提供精细的细节来指导超解析.
对于每个间隔,RelayVSR可以单独使用第一个键框来避免输入的外观前端或两个端点,来用有边框的外观前端进行更丰富的参考指导.
键帧间隔决定了大型基因模型在多大程度上经常更新这些参考文献,从而决定其每个输出框架的摊余成本.
图1说明了这一时间表以及具有代表性的VSR结果。
在单NVIDIA A100 80GB上的1080p上,具有15帧键帧间隔的双端模式的完整系统运行于29.29 FPS,拥有13.82GB峰值的GPU内存,而FlashVSR-Tiny则使用7.80 FPS和24.447 GB.

blocks.en:
First, we adapt a pretrained video generation model ( Wan et al., 2025 ) to frame-wise target keyframe latents, followed by one-step GAN distillation with a relativistic adversarial objective ( Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2018 ) .
Second, to exploit the rich generative priors encoded in the keyframe latents, we design a lightweight (ii) Dual-Memory Video Transformer .
The network super-resolves each video interval sequentially using keyframe latents from its first frame or both endpoints.
Persistent keyframe and rolling video memories cache keys and values from keyframes and recent frames, respectively.
Current LR tokens query both memories to combine keyframe details with local temporal context.
Together with keyframe super-resolution, this design enables efficient streaming VSR while retaining the perceptual benefits of the large model’s generative priors.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们改编一个经过预先训练的视频生成模型(Wan等人,2025年),用于帧式目标键框潜伏,然后是单步GAN蒸馏,并具有相对性对抗目标(Jolicoeur-Martineau,2018年).
第二,为了利用密钥框中编码的丰富的基因前科,我们设计了一个轻量级(二)双记忆视频变形器。
网络超级解析了每个视频间隔,依次使用其第一个帧或两个端点的键框潜伏.
持续键框和滚动视频记忆缓存键和键框和最近帧的值分别存在.
当前 LR 令牌查询两种记忆,将键框细节与本地时间上下文相结合.
这种设计与键框超分辨率一起,使VSR能够高效流畅,同时保留大模型基因前科的感知利益。

blocks.en:
However, sharing keyframe latents across frames also spreads the effects of keyframe errors.
Our experiments show that texture and color errors in super-resolved keyframes propagate to non-keyframes and accumulate during video super-resolution.
Adapting the lightweight VSR network to keyframe latents produced by the large model remains insufficient to prevent this propagation.
These findings expose an objective mismatch: optimizing keyframe quality alone does not account for how the lightweight network uses keyframe latents to super-resolve the full video.
We term this mismatch the Collaboration Gap .
Addressing it calls for optimizing keyframe super-resolution with feedback from the video produced by the lightweight network.
blocks.zh:
然而,跨框架共享关键框架的潜在作用也分散了关键框架错误的影响。
我们的实验表明,超解密钥框的纹理和颜色错误向非键框传播,并在视频超解时积累.
使轻量级VSR网络适应大型模型产生的关键框架潜力仍然不足以防止这种传播。
这些发现暴露了一种客观的不匹配:仅优化键框质量并不能说明轻量级网络如何使用键框潜伏物来超解完整视频.
我们称之为协作差距
解决这一问题,需要利用轻量级网络制作的视频的反馈,优化关键框架超分辨率。

blocks.en:
To address this gap, we introduce (iii) Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO) , which trains the large model using reward feedback from the video super-resolved by the lightweight VSR network.
During post-training, the system-level reward evaluates the HR videos super-resolved by the fixed lightweight network using the large model’s keyframe latents, focusing on non-keyframe quality, temporal consistency, and continuity across keyframe updates.
The large model therefore learns from how its keyframe latents affect the frames that use them.
A complementary reference-level reward evaluates the decoded keyframes for content fidelity and realistic detail, maintaining a direct quality objective alongside downstream video feedback.
We implement VARO using DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , updating only the large model with the combined reward.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了(三)视频-智能参考优化(VARO),它利用轻量级VSR网络的视频超级解析的奖励反馈来训练大型模型.
在培训后,系统层面的奖励评价了固定轻量级网络利用大模型的关键框架潜质而超级解决的HR视频,重点是非关键框架的质量、时间一致性以及关键框架更新的连续性。
因此,大型模型从它的关键框架的潜在作用如何影响使用它们的框架中吸取教训。
补充的参考级奖励评价了解码的关键框架内容忠实性和现实细节,在下游视频反馈的同时保持了直接的质量目标.
我们使用DifmusionNFT(郑等人,2026年)实施VARO,仅更新大模型与综合奖励.

blocks.en:
Experiments demonstrate that RelayVSR achieves a favorable balance between super-resolution quality and inference efficiency compared with other diffusion-based VSR methods.
With reference keyframes spaced 15 frames apart, its dual-endpoint configuration processes 1080p video at 29.29 FPS on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB, with peak allocated GPU memory of 13.82 GB.
Ablations further show that VARO improves final video quality over direct joint training, and that combining reference-level and system-level rewards yields better results than system-level feedback alone.
blocks.zh:
实验证明,与其它基于扩散的VSR方法相比,RelayVSR在超分辨率质量和推论效率之间实现了有利的平衡.
在参考键框间隔15帧的情况下,其双端点配置过程在单NVIDIA A100 80GB上的29.29 FPS上为1080p视频,峰值分配GPU内存为13.82GB.
差异进一步表明,VARO比直接联合培训改进了最终视频质量,将参考级别和系统级别奖励结合起来,比单是系统一级反馈效果更好。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Real-World Video Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 2.1 真实世界视频超级分辨率

blocks.en:
Conventional VSR methods recover high-resolution frames through temporal alignment and feature aggregation, with real-world extensions addressing complex degradations ( Chan et al., 2022a ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Chan et al., 2022b ; Zhang & Yao, 2024 ) .
Diffusion-based methods further exploit image and video generative priors for detail synthesis, with temporal modeling or motion guidance to maintain consistency ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025b ) .
Their sampling cost has motivated one-step VSR methods that replace iterative denoising with a single forward pass ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025a ) .
Beyond sampling, FlashVSR ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) reduces attention and decoding costs with locality-constrained sparse attention and an LR-conditioned lightweight decoder, while SwiftVR ( Yan et al., 2026 ) combines shifted-window attention with a lightweight autoencoder for streaming inference.
Stream-DiffVSR ( Shiu et al., 2026 ) combines a distilled denoiser with motion-aligned temporal guidance for causal, frame-by-frame processing.
PS-SR ( Wu et al., 2026 ) also distributes computation between models, using a large model for an initial denoising step and a lightweight model for subsequent refinements.
RelayVSR instead combines sparse keyframe super-resolution by a large generative model with lightweight frame-by-frame processing to enable fast, high-quality streaming VSR.
blocks.zh:
常规VSR方法通过时间对齐和特征聚合恢复高分辨率框架,现实世界的扩展处理复杂的降解(Chan等人,2022a); 梁等,2022;陈等,2022b;张和姚,2024).
基于传播的方法进一步利用图像和视频的基因前科进行详细合成,并附有时间模型或运动指导,以保持一致性(周等人,2024年;杨等人,2024年;谢等人,2025年;王等人,2025年;李等人,2025年b).
它们的采样成本促使采用一步的VSR方法,用单一前传取代迭代代代号(Chen等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年;Sun等人,2026年;Li等人,2025年a).
除了采样外,FlashVSR( Zhu等,2026年)还减少注意和解码费用,因为局部受限的注意力稀少,以及一个LR条件的轻量级解码器,而SwiftVR( Yan等,2026年)则将转向窗的注意与轻量级自动编码器结合用于流推.
Stream- DiffVSR 软件 (Shiu等人,2026年)将蒸馏的脱氧酯与运动同步的时间指导结合,用于因果处理,逐帧处理.
PS-SR(Wu等人,2026年)也在模型之间分配计算,使用一个大型模型进行初始去诺步骤,以及一个轻量级模型进行后续的改进.
中继VSR转而通过大型基因模型将稀疏的密钥帧超分辨率与轻量级帧逐帧处理结合起来,从而能够快速,高质量的流流VSR.

blocks.en: 2.2 Reference-Guided Video Super-Resolution
blocks.zh: 2.2 参考-指导视频超级分辨率

blocks.en:
Reference-guided VSR supplements LR videos with fine details from high-quality reference frames.
RefVSR and ERVSR obtain these references from an additional wide-angle camera to super-resolve ultra-wide videos ( Lee et al., 2022 ; Kim et al., 2023 ) .
Within this multi-camera setting, RefVSR++ ( Zou et al., 2025 ) improves temporal aggregation by separately propagating reference features and fused LR–reference features.
References can also be obtained from the LR video itself through image super-resolution.
DAM-VSR ( Kong et al., 2025 ) uses such references to guide appearance in video diffusion, while the LR sequence provides motion guidance.
SparkVSR ( Yu et al., 2026 ) similarly conditions a large video diffusion model on super-resolved keyframes, combining their sparse latents with LR video latents to enable interactive VSR.
In RelayVSR, generated keyframe latents instead guide a lightweight VSR network.
The network retains reference information in persistent keyframe memory and incorporates recent temporal context through rolling video memory, supporting frame-by-frame super-resolution.
blocks.zh:
参考指南VSR补编 LR视频中包含来自高质量参考框架的精细细节.
RefVSR和ERVSR从一个额外的广角相机获得这些参考到超级解析超广视频(Lee等人,2022年;Kim等人,2023年).
在这种多相机环境下,RefVSR++(Zou等人,2025年)通过单独传播参考特征和连接的LR-参考特征改进了时间汇总。
参考文献也可以通过图像超分辨率从LR视频本身获得.
DAM-VSR(Kong等人,2025年)在视频传播中使用这种参考来指导外观,而LR序列则提供运动指导.
SparkVSR(Yu等人,2026年)同样在超级解析键框上为大型视频传播模型提供了条件,将其稀疏的潜伏物与LR视频潜伏物结合,使互动VSR成为可能.
在RelayVSR中,生成了键框潜伏,而引导一个轻量级VSR网络.
该网络保留了持久性键框内存中的参考信息,并通过滚动的视频内存纳入了最近的时间背景,支持一个帧的超分辨率.

blocks.en: 2.3 Preference Optimization for Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.3 最佳传播模式

blocks.en:
Reinforcement learning and preference optimization enable diffusion models to learn from feedback beyond their original denoising objectives.
DDPO ( Black et al., 2024 ) formulates denoising as a sequential decision process and applies policy gradient optimization, while Diffusion-DPO ( Wallace et al., 2024 ) learns directly from pairwise preferences.
DiffusionNFT ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) incorporates reward feedback into forward-process flow matching, enabling policy optimization without likelihood estimation.
blocks.zh:
强化学习和优化偏好使传播模式能够从反馈中学习超越其最初的去名目标.
DDPO(Black等人,2024年)将去诺化作为顺序决定过程,并应用政策梯度优化,而DDPO(Wallace等人,2024年)则直接从双向偏好中学习.
传播NFT (郑等人,2026年)将奖励反馈纳入前程流程匹配,使政策优化无概率估计.

blocks.en:
For image super-resolution, RFSR ( Sun et al., 2024 ) combines perceptual reward feedback with structural constraints, while GDPO-SR ( Yi et al., 2026 ) adapts group-based preference optimization to one-step generative models.
Recent work further incorporates fidelity to the LR input: LucidNFT ( Fei et al., 2026 ) combines perceptual and LR-referenced faithfulness rewards through DiffusionNFT, while OARS ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) evaluates fidelity preservation and perceptual gain in the LR-to-SR transition.
These methods optimize the quality of the SR images produced by the model being updated.
In RelayVSR, the large generative model produces reference latents for sparse keyframes to guide a lightweight VSR network.
The designed VARO optimizes the large generative model through reinforcement learning with two reward levels—a system-level reward and a reference-level reward—while keeping the lightweight VSR network fixed.
blocks.zh:
对于图像超分辨率,RFSR(Sun等人,2024年)将知觉奖励反馈与结构约束相结合,而GDPO-SR(Yi等人,2026年)则将基于群体的偏好优化调整为单步基因模型.
最近的工作进一步纳入了对LR输入的忠诚度:LucidNFT(Fei等人,2026年)通过DifmusionNFT结合了知觉和LR参考的忠诚度奖励,而OARS(Zhao等人,2026年)则在LR到SR的过渡中评价忠诚度的保持和知觉收益.
这些方法优化了正在更新的模型所产生的SR图像的质量.
在RelayVSR中,大基因模型为稀疏的键框产生参考潜质,以引导轻量级VSR网络.
设计出来的VARO通过强化学习优化了大型基因模型,奖励分为两个级别——系统级奖励和参考级奖励——同时保持轻量级VSR网络的固定.

blocks.zh: 3 方法

Bottom left: the lightweight VSR network super-resolves every frame by jointly attending to persistent keyframe and rolling video memories. blocks.en:
RelayVSR assigns sparse keyframe super-resolution to a large generative model and uses the generated reference latents to guide a lightweight VSR network in super-resolving every frame (Fig. 2 ).
We first describe the Sparse Generative Relay (Sec. 3.1 ) and the Dual-Memory Video Transformer that combines reusable references with recent video context (Sec. 3.2 ).
Finally, Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO) uses reinforcement learning to update the large generative model with a system-level reward and a reference-level reward, while keeping the lightweight VSR network fixed (Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.1 Sparse Generative Relay
blocks.zh: 3.1 分层基因中继器

blocks.en:
Let X = { x t } t = 1 T X=\{x_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} denote the LR input video and Y = { y t } t = 1 T Y=\{y_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} its HR training target.

The large generative model produces a reference latent z ^ j \hat{z}_{j} for each selected frame and passes it directly to the lightweight VSR network without RGB decoding.
The lightweight network uses these references and the LR video to super-resolve every frame, including those at keyframe positions.

During training, a block-causal attention mask limits temporal attention to tokens from the current keyframe and recent keyframes within a fixed window.
In Stage 2 , we use GAN distillation to obtain a one-step reference generator, combining a latent reconstruction loss with a relativistic adversarial (RSGAN) objective ( Jolicoeur-Martineau, 2018 ) .

Between consecutive keyframes k j k_{j} and k j + 1 k_{j+1} , the lightweight VSR network super-resolves frames sequentially using the LR video and the selected reference latents.
In first-keyframe mode , the network uses the left reference and causal LR context without future-frame dependency.
In dual-endpoint mode , it also uses the right reference, introducing bounded input lookahead.
The large generative model runs only at keyframes, with Δ \Delta controlling its invocation frequency, while the lightweight network reuses the generated references to super-resolve every frame.

blocks.en: 3.2 Dual-Memory Video Transformer
blocks.zh: 3.2 双记忆视频变形器

blocks.en:
Our lightweight VSR network, the Dual-Memory Video Transformer F ϕ F_{\phi} , super-resolves each incoming LR frame using generated reference latents and information from recent frames.
We use a convolutional encoder to extract features from the LR frame and a separate projection to process the reference latents.
Both produce spatial tokens with the same feature dimension for the Transformer.
blocks.zh:
我们的轻量级 VSR 网络,双记忆视频变形器 F φ F_{\F_{\phi}, 超级解析每个进入的 LR 帧,使用生成的参考潜伏和来自最近帧的信息.
我们用一个进化编码器从 LR 框架提取特征, 和一个单独的投影处理参考潜伏物。
两者都为变形器产生具有相同特征维度的空间符号.

blocks.en:
To reuse keyframe information across output frames, we process each reference independently, applying self-attention among its own spatial tokens at each Transformer layer.
Because this reference processing is independent of video features, we precompute its layer-wise keys and values and store them in a persistent keyframe memory .
Super-resolving successive frames also requires recent temporal context to complement the reusable keyframe information.
We therefore maintain a rolling video memory that stores the layer-wise keys and values of recently processed video frames and is updated after each frame.

为了重复使用跨输出框架的密钥框架信息,我们独立处理每个参考,在每个变形器层的空间符号中应用自我注意。
由于这种参考处理独立于视频功能,我们预先计算其分层的密钥和值,并将其存储在一个持久的密钥框内存中.
超解连续帧还需要最近的时间背景来补充可重复使用的密钥帧信息.
因此,我们维持一个滚动的视频内存,存储最近处理的视频帧的层层密钥和值,并在每个帧后更新。

blocks.en: 3.3 Video-Aware Reference Optimization
blocks.zh: 3.3 视频智能参考优化

blocks.en:
The lightweight VSR network is trained with reference latents encoded from ground-truth HR keyframes, whereas inference uses references generated from LR keyframes by the large generative model.
Texture and color errors in these generated references can propagate and accumulate as they are reused across frames.
Keyframe-level objectives do not capture these downstream effects.
VARO addresses this Collaboration Gap through reinforcement learning with system-level and reference-level rewards, optimizing the large generative model for both reference and video quality while keeping the lightweight VSR network fixed.

这些生成的参考文献中的纹理和颜色错误可以传播和累积,因为它们被跨框重复使用。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
RelayVSR uses Wan2.2-TI2V-5B as its large generative model and a 31.9M-parameter lightweight VSR network; training draws on approximately 0.5M videos and 1M images.
We adapt the large model with rank-512 LoRA for 75K flow-matching steps, followed by 5K steps of one-step GAN distillation.
Both stages use eight-frame video clips sampled with random temporal strides and single images, with 704 × 1280 704\times 1280 HR crops and batch sizes of 32 and 96, respectively.
We use AdamW with learning rates of 2e-5 for flow matching and 1e-5 for GAN distillation.
The lightweight VSR network is trained from scratch for 60K steps on 16-frame clips with 1024 × 1536 1024\times 1536 HR crops and a batch size of 64, using AdamW with a learning rate of 1e-4.
VARO then updates the large model with DiffusionNFT while keeping the lightweight VSR network fixed.
Additional training details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
中继VSR使用Wan2.2-TI2V-5B作为其大基因模型和一个31.9M参数轻量级VSR网络;培训借鉴了约0.5M视频和1M图像.
我们改造了大型型号,以级号为512LORA,用于75K的流量匹配步骤,然后是5K步的GAN蒸馏.
两个阶段都使用八帧视频片段抽样,随机时间跨度和单一图像,有704×1280704\时 人力资源作物1280种,批量规模分别为32种和96种.
我们使用 AdamW 的学习速率是 2e-5 进行流量匹配, 1e-5 进行 GAN 蒸馏.
轻量级VSR网络从零开始训练,在16帧的夹片上为60K步,有1024×1536 1024\时 1536种HR作物和批量规模64种,使用AdamW,学习率1e-4.
VARO随后用DifmusionNFT更新了大型模型,同时保持轻量级VSR网络的固定.
补充培训详情见附录B。

blocks.en:
We assess 4 × 4\times VSR on three synthetic benchmarks (REDS30, UDM10, and YouHQ40) and the real-world VideoLQ benchmark.
For the synthetic sets, LR inputs are generated from HR videos with the same RealBasicVSR degradation pipeline ( Chan et al., 2022b ) used for training.
For sustained streaming, we use LongVSR60, which contains 30 real-world and 30 AI-generated single-shot videos of approximately 1,000 frames each.
The main comparison includes RealViformer ( Zhang & Yao, 2024 ) , STAR ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , DOVE ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , SeedVR2 ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , SparkVSR ( Yu et al., 2026 ) , SwiftVR ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , and FlashVSR ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) .
Throughout the paper, FlashVSR refers to its Tiny v1.1 variant.
For paired synthetic videos, we measure reconstruction fidelity with PSNR and SSIM and perceptual similarity with LPIPS.
We assess no-reference quality with NIQE, MUSIQ, CLIP-IQA, and DOVER on both synthetic and real-world videos.
A blind pairwise user study is described in Appendix C.4 .

就合成设备而言,LR输入来自人力资源录像,该录像与用于培训的RealBasicVSR降解管道(Chan等人,2022年b)相同。
对于持续流媒体,我们使用LongVSR60,它包含30个真实世界和30个AI生成的单镜头视频,每个视频大约1000帧.

我们评估NIQE、MUSIQ、CLIP-IQA和DOVER在合成和现实世界视频上的不参考质量。

blocks.en:
Table 1 shows that RelayVSR maintains strong full-video quality with dual-endpoint conditioning and large-model calls spaced 15 frames apart.
Across the three paired benchmarks, it surpasses FlashVSR in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
It achieves the best LPIPS (0.2569) and DOVER (0.7313) on YouHQ40, the best DOVER on REDS30 (0.4010), and the best SSIM (0.7545) and MUSIQ (65.32) on UDM10.
On real-world VideoLQ, RelayVSR leads in MUSIQ (51.26) and DOVER (0.5488), while FlashVSR performs better in NIQE and CLIP-IQA.
The evaluation covers complete output videos rather than keyframes alone.

blocks.en: 4.3 System Efficiency Analysis

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows the efficiency gains from invoking the large generative model only at sparse keyframes.
On 201-frame clips at 1080p using one NVIDIA A100-80G, RelayVSR in dual-endpoint mode reaches 29.29 FPS with 13.82 GB peak allocated memory.
This is 3.76 × 3.76\times the throughput of FlashVSR (7.80 FPS, 24.45 GB) while using 43.5% less memory; SwiftVR, the fastest baseline in the table, reaches 23.48 FPS.
Switching to first-keyframe mode raises throughput to 35.89 FPS and reduces peak memory to 13.72 GB; the first output requires 0.183 s of model computation, compared with 0.327 s in dual-endpoint mode.
In a real streaming system, dual-endpoint mode must also wait for the future keyframe to arrive—up to 0.500 s at a 30-FPS input rate—before it can output frames in that interval.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study

blocks.en:
The efficiency gains above rely on each sparse reference guiding many lightweight VSR updates.
We therefore examine how reference and video memories contribute to video quality, then test whether VARO makes the shared references more useful to the final video (Tables 3 and 4 ).
blocks.zh:
以上效率的提高依赖于指导许多轻量级VSR更新的每一个稀疏参考。
因此,我们审查参考和录像记忆如何促进录像质量,然后检验VARO是否使共用的参考资料对最后的录像更有用(表3和表4)。

blocks.en:
The two memory streams play complementary roles in sparse-reference VSR.
Table 3 removes either reference memory or rolling video memory from the lightweight VSR network.
All variants use the same training data, budget, and inference schedule; variants with references share the same pre-VARO one-step generator.
Adding references to the video-memory-only variant raises MUSIQ from 56.80 to 63.72 and DOVER from 0.4760 to 0.5290, showing the contribution of generative keyframe information to output quality.
Adding video memory to the reference-only variant further improves DOVER from 0.5110 to 0.5290 and MS from 0.9769 to 0.9830, while retaining similar MUSIQ (63.65 vs. 63.72).
Video memory alone has the highest MS (0.9911), while dual memory yields the best MUSIQ and DOVER and improves MS over reference memory alone.

blocks.en:
VARO improves references according to the video they help produce.
Table 4 compares reward variants initialized from the same one-step GAN generator, with the lightweight VSR network fixed.
Full VARO raises all-frame MUSIQ from 63.72 to 65.32, DOVER from 0.5290 to 0.5448, and MS from 0.9830 to 0.9900 over the model without post-training.
The two reward levels favor different aspects: reference-level feedback alone yields higher keyframe MUSIQ than system-level feedback (64.95 vs. 64.42), whereas system-level feedback gives stronger all-frame MUSIQ, DOVER, and MS.
Combining them improves all four reported scores, including keyframe MUSIQ to 65.18.
Thus, evaluating both the generated references and the final video provides a more effective training signal for large–small model collaboration.

因此,评价生成的参考文献和最后录像为大型-小型模型合作提供了更有效的培训信号。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
RelayVSR makes generative real-world video super-resolution efficient by sharing sparse large-model outputs across frames.
A large generative model supplies keyframe reference latents, and a lightweight VSR network uses dual memory to carry their detail through the video while tracking recent temporal context.
Video-Aware Reference Optimization (VARO) trains the large generative model using feedback on both decoded keyframes and the resulting video, making the references more useful to the lightweight VSR network.
Experiments show that this collaboration delivers strong full-video quality while amortizing large-model computation across frames.
RelayVSR leads the compared methods in LPIPS and DOVER on YouHQ40 and in MUSIQ and DOVER on real-world VideoLQ.
At 1080p with Δ = 15 \Delta=15 , dual-endpoint mode reaches 29.29 model-computation FPS with 13.82 GB peak allocated GPU memory; first-keyframe mode reaches 35.89 FPS without future-frame input.
These results demonstrate how reusable references and downstream optimization extend the benefits of a large generative model across an entire video.
Adapting reference placement to scene dynamics is a promising direction for further improving the quality–latency trade-off.
blocks.zh:
RelayVSR通过跨帧共享稀疏的大型模型输出,使得基因现实世界视频超分辨率高效.
大型基因模型提供键框参考潜伏物,轻量级VSR网络在跟踪近期时间背景的同时,使用双重内存来通过视频携带其细节.
Video-Aware Reference Optimation(VARO)利用解码键框和由此产生的视频的反馈来训练大型基因模型,使得参考文献对轻量级VSR网络更有用.
实验显示,这种协作提供了强大的全视频质量,同时跨帧分期摊销大模型计算.
RelayVSR在LPIPS和DOVER在YouHQ40上以及MUSIQ和DOVER在现实世界VideoLQ上领导比较方法.
在1080p与QQ=15\Delta=15,双端点模式达到29.29模型-计算FPS,13.82GB峰值分配GPU内存;首键模式达到35.89 FPS,没有未来帧输入.
这些结果表明,可重复使用的参考文献和下游优化如何将大型基因模型的好处扩展到整个视频。
调整参考位置以适应场景动态,是进一步提高质量-相关性权衡的一个有希望的方向。

blocks.en:
For a spatially padded LR input of size h × w h\times w , the LR encoder reduces the grid to h / 4 × w / 4 h/4\times w/4 .
The frozen VAE encodes a 4 × 4\times HR keyframe with spatial stride 16, giving a reference latent on the same grid.
The LR and reference streams use separate input RMS normalization and type embeddings before entering the shared Transformer width.

Reference tokens use spatial RoPE and a common reference type embedding, with no left/right endpoint role encoding.
Their layer-wise K/V therefore depend on the reference content rather than its role in an interval; the cached right endpoint can serve as the next interval’s left endpoint without being encoded again.

The eligible reference, history, and current-frame K/V in Eq. ( 1 ) participate in one grouped-query attention softmax ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) .
Reference and video streams have separate K/V projections and RMS-normalized K/V features, while sharing the attention normalization, query and output projections, and SwiGLU feed-forward network.
Recent video frames are close in time, so a small neighborhood focuses on nearby motion cues at low attention cost.
Sparse references may be Δ \Delta frames away; a wider neighborhood lets each query search for corresponding details across larger displacements.
Both neighborhoods are centered on the current query, keeping the search local rather than attending to the entire frame; at image boundaries, only valid tokens are included.
The current video query has temporal RoPE position zero, while retained video frames have negative relative offsets; reference tokens use only spatial RoPE.
At most W − 1 W-1 preceding video frames can contribute K/V to a query, with W W including the current frame.

blocks.en:
VARO trains on 46-frame clips with keyframes at positions 1, 16, 31, and 46, giving three complete intervals under dual-endpoint conditioning.
For each LR–HR clip, the sampling policy draws four candidate reference sequences, each of which receives one combined reward for its full rollout.
Two clips per update therefore produce eight scored rollouts.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en:
RelayVSR uses a fixed keyframe interval, while dual-endpoint conditioning
requires bounded lookahead. Adapting keyframe placement and reference
selection to content changes and latency budgets could improve the balance
between video quality and computational cost.
Texture or color errors in generated references can propagate across output
frames. Complementing VARO with reference reliability estimation at inference
could guide memory reading and reference refresh, helping the lightweight VSR
network adjust its reliance on generated details.
Although sparse invocation reduces average computation, the large generative
model still contributes to memory use. Our efficiency results are measured
on an NVIDIA A100. Model compression and smaller reference generators could
support deployment on devices with tighter resource budgets.
